notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4d Early Access
notes.notes:
Improvements:

 Best gameplay yet. Lots of tuning across the board for improved gameplay feel for Default physics. Heavily recommended you use this physics. Others will need tuning.
 Improved Catching System: Catching now using regular continuous collision not continuous speculative, allowing for more complex catches.
 Clutch Tackle System: Players dive tackle at different angles after catches, in the end zone and when a QB is winding up for a pass.
 In-season practice mode now is your team vs itself in your home stadium.
 Added more gameplay footage to background video
 Under the hood optimizations in CPU and GPU across the board.
 Players fall down more realistically.
 Better blocking with blockers that seal the edges.
 Better tackling targeting.
 Coverage defenders who cover a blocker will go back into zone coverage.
 Better tipped passes.
 Beginning stadium renovations and optimizations. Seats optimized in Atlanta, Houston, Kansas


Bug Fixes:

 Fix for rumble issues.
 Fixes for create a player
 Fixes for all-star team players being incorrect.
 Fix for OL flying up in the air during passrush.
 Fix for UI sound issues.
 Fix for jersey select not working in season mode.
 Fixes for other issues in season mode with roster.
 Fix for NPC feet dragging on ground.
 Fix for coach in season mode not walking on floor properly.
 Fix for QB sneak animation issues.


Known Issues:

 AI misses too many FGs.
 AI players can’t get up after plays.
 Co-op issues like both possessing the QB at the same time and Player 2 needing to press A to snap even though he’s not the QB.
 DB arms don’t reach out for ball sometimes in pass coverage.
 Playbook line renderers on field have wrong points and rotations sometimes.
 Punter doesn’t transition to run after punt animation
 IK catching physics issues (edge case)
 Defenders shouldn’t strafe when taking 45 degree pursuit angle
 Catching is harder. Requires concentration. Needs a “vacuum” feature where it slowly pulls you into the correct catch point while also maintaining player control, kind of like aim assist.
 Punts land too far downfield, farther than throw target reticle.
 Run with ball animation isn’t used sometimes for ballcarrier when it should be, creating a fumble vulnerability by not tucking.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3b Early Access

Features:

 QB throw platform system with proper QB throw animation (finally). Hold R1 to do running throws, which have 50% power reduction. Not holding R1 and releasing sets your feet to throw. More animations to come. 
 Added Ratings to Data: Stamina, Durability, ThrowAccuracyShort, ThrowAccuracyMedium, ThrowAccuracyDeep, ThrowOnTheRun, BreakTackle, LeadBlock, ImpactBlocking, SpectacularCatch, CatchInTraffic, ShortRouteRunning, MediumRouteRunning, DeepRouteRunning, Tackle.
 Implemented Ratings into gameplay: Stamina, ThrowOnTheRun, BreakTackle, StiffArm, Tackle.


Improvements:

 Significant gameplay improvements. Removed contextual muscleSpring and muscleDamper overrides which weren’t even implemented properly. Gameplay is very nice now. Everyone does their assignment. Hard hits. Minimal glitches. No random falling down.
 Significant performance improvements including CPU, GPU, memory and disk usage, including loading and physics: 
 Game running on Steam Deck: 20-30 FPS on Steam Deck with everything on. 60 FPS achievable with specific settings.
 Animation improvements to QB throw, P punting, C stance and others.
 IK catching improvements.
 Improved playbook design.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.05r14 Early Access

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.05r13 Early Access
notes.notes:

 Reduced SSAO intensity. Grass looks better now.

Bug Fixes: 

 Fixed bug where hitting Next during playoffs would Sim your game.
 Fix for kicker punting the ball multiple times causing the ball to teleport in random directions
 Improved punt blocking

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.03 Early Access
notes.notes:
Patch v0.03 is up! If it crashes after the update, please uninstall, delete all .json files and re-install the game.

New Additions:

 Mods are now in the “Mods” folder. The default Mod is called “Default”.
 Multiple mods can be stored and switched at runtime in the Main Menu options.
 Moddable Helmet, Jersey and Pants textures. To use, add textures to the Textures folder and name them correctly. Use Material #6 in the teams.csv. See the Phoenixes in the Default mod for an example. Use FootballPlayer.fbx in the Mods folder to test your textures.
 League logo on the field is now moddable. Replace loading_logo.png in the Images folder.
 RenderScale in Quality settings now works.
 Match start performance optimized by setting asyncUploadTimeSlice to 16 miliseconds and asyncUploadBufferSize to 256MB.
 Playbook page navigation numbers
 New background city (v3)


Bug Fixes:

 Pause menu no longer selects a play upon resuming
 Standard play selection no longer being overridden by kickoff when spamming buttons
 During the pre-match flyby, one of the jets was missing
 Fantasy draft team can now be changed after backing out of fantasy draft screen
 Temporarily grayed out ‘team select’ and ‘options’ in pause menu until they work properly
 Season Mode play choices now restricted by whether or not they’ve been collected
 No more kicking straight up
 Kickoff touchback no longer softlocks by setting line of scrimmage at the goalpost 


Notes:

 Any mod content in the root folder can now be deleted (Images, csv files, etc). It can now be found in Mods/Default.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.02 Early Access
notes.notes:
New Additions:
-	New intro cinematic
-	Pimped out the blimp
-	Arizona Roadrunners team logo visual update
-	Some more announcer audio
-	Maximum passing is now on by default
-	Replays now begin at the snap (but can still be rewound)
-	Added "(Very Slow)" to the Grass in options.

Bug Fixes:
-	Infinite pile-in bug fix
-	Kickoff arrow no longer aims below ground, causing softlock where the ball to goes beneath the field
-	Line of scrimmage color changed from yellow to blue (to differentiate from first down line)
-	Ball no longer disappears off-screen during replays
-	Volume sliders are now properly split (sfx, announcer, crowd)
-	Point After Touchdown right before Halftime no longer skipped
-	kicking the ball out of bounds sets the ball to 25 yard line
-	Player possession is more immediate and responsive (after handoff, when switching with B, or when receiving the ball)
-	Audiovisual issues fixed on Load and New Season menus
-	Offensive line during field goal attempts won’t block their own kick
